user_text: Perfect, that's done. Wow, it's really late.
text:
It really has been a marathon session! You've built out a solid toolkit — cleanup, dedup, phone/date/park normalization, theme coding, theme summary, and satisfaction pivot, all wired into a single script with a menu, permissions, and protection. Nice work sticking with it through all those iterations.

Get some rest, and when you're ready to run it, you know where to find me if anything needs adjusting. Good night!
